title: salix novae-angliae
intro: Salix novae-angliae, commonly known as River Birch, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to eastern North America. It is valued for its health benefits, including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Salix novae-angliae include its ability to act as an astringent, anti-diarrheal, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it useful for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Salix novae-angliae include salicylic acid, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
